title: Page Definition
description:
One page of an experience: the unit that is generated, edited, validated, versioned and rendered. This is the platform's central contract — the renderer, the visual builder, the validator, the generation service and the migration tooling all bind to it.

Three structural decisions shape the whole document. Components live in a keyed map rather than nested inside the layout, so JSON Patch paths into a component stay stable when siblings are reordered and so two-stage AI generation maps directly onto layout-then-components. Page state is declared explicitly as parameters, filter channels and selection channels, so interaction is expressible in JSON and the renderer can derive the data invalidation graph statically. And nothing here names a physical data object, which is what makes a published page promotable between environments byte-identically.

kind.description: Page archetype. Drives default layout heuristics, default page actions, and which AI generation exemplars are retrieved. 'workspace' is read plus write-back (v2); 'process' is workflow-hosted (v3) and reserved.

route.description: Path segment within the experience. Parameters appear as ':name' and must be declared in parameters.

parameters.description: Typed inputs to the page. URL-synced when scope is 'page' or 'experience', which makes every filtered state deep-linkable — the mechanism by which an analyst sends a colleague the exact view of an exception queue under discussion.

filters.description: Shared filter channels: declared page state that components read and write. Declaring them rather than letting components hold state is what allows cross-widget filtering to be generated by the AI and analysed by the renderer.

selections.description: Selection channels — which row, point or node is active. Separate from filters because selection drives detail regions and drill-down rather than narrowing queries.

entity.description: Catalog entity the selected value identifies. Lets a drilldown action derive its key mapping without the author restating it.

dataSources.description: Named logical queries available to this page's components.

components.description: Component instances keyed by id, referenced from the layout tree. A flat map rather than a nested tree: it keeps patch paths stable, makes impact analysis a simple query, and lets AI generation emit the layout plan and the component configurations as separate stages.

layout.description: Root of the structural tree. Conventionally a grid container.

overlays.description: Drawers and modals not part of the main flow, opened by actions. Kept out of the layout tree so they do not affect grid arrangement.

actions.description: Named actions available to this page. Components reference them by id from eventActions; nothing in a component decides what an interaction means.

themeRef.description: Design token set. A reference, never inline colours — theming, contrast and dark mode stay under the design system's control, so a generated page cannot produce an inaccessible palette.

headerSummary.description: Component rendered in the page header — the record summary on a detail page.

stringTableRef.description: External string table for i18nString keys used in this page, so a published experience can be localized without editing content.

maxEagerDataSources.description: Fan-out cap for the first batch. Excess sources are deferred rather than dropped, and the deferral is recorded — silent truncation would make a page appear complete when it is not.

scope.description: 'page' resets on navigation. 'experience' persists across pages within the experience, which is how an as-of date chosen on a dashboard survives a drill into detail instead of silently resetting. 'session' persists for the whole session.

boundToEntity.description: Catalog entity this parameter identifies an instance of. Present on detail-page key parameters so the platform can label the record, resolve breadcrumbs and validate drill-down mappings without the author restating the relationship.

allowedValues.description: Constrains accepted values. Validated server-side on page load: a parameter arriving from a URL is user input and is never trusted, though it is also never a security boundary — entitlement is enforced independently by the gateway.

boundToAttribute.description: Catalog attribute this channel filters. Lets the platform generate the filter control, its label and its value list from the catalog — including real enum values, so a generated filter offers actual values rather than plausible invented ones.

persist.description: Remember the user's last value across visits.
